evals.name: editor-role
evals.prompt: Only catalog editors may register an author. Protect the existing command.
assertions: Keeps inputs and event decision unchanged.

evals.name: author-access
evals.prompt: What does the registration pipeline return to an anonymous caller, a reader and an editor?
assertions: Checks IsAuthorized false and no append for anonymous and reader callers.
Tests the server pipeline rather than directly calling Handle.

evals.name: signed-in-query
evals.prompt: Require sign-in alone for author queries, but a role for one query method.
evals.expected_output: Read model authorization with a method override.
assertions: Uses Authorize without roles for authentication alone.
Places the common declaration on the read model.
Treats the method declaration as overriding rather than adding role lists.
